topics.title: Radio Guests Discuss Strange Events and News
topics.summary: A radio show features callers discussing bizarre events including a man mistaking his wife for a hat and obsessive hand washing habits alongside commentary on news stories about the death of a young black child with a yearbook photo presented, sparking debate over background information.

topics.title: Teaneck Shooting Investigation - Initial Confusion
topics.summary: Following a high school student’s death involving a firearm in Teaneck, New Jersey, investigators are examining the circumstances. The discussion quickly shifts to conflicting accounts of the events and racial tensions surrounding the shooting, with hosts expressing confusion about details and attempting to frame the situation.

topics.title: Geraldo and the Dice Divorce
topics.summary: During a discussion about Geraldo’s show, the hosts dissect a former wife's claim that she married comedian Dice early in his career. They question her appearance on the program, speculating about altered makeup while debating their relationship and suggesting DICE may have lost interest in her.

topics.title: Divorce, Comedy & Computer Professionals
topics.summary: During a radio segment, computer professional Pino Rivera discusses his recent divorce and the legal complexities involved, including potential alimony claims based on past earnings and California law regarding asset division. He expresses frustration with the process and questions comedic talent while referencing previous relationships and a gangster show he appeared in.

topics.title: Radio Chaos and AIDS Boy News
topics.summary: The broadcast features a chaotic segment with Howard, Gary, and others discussing bizarre events including a comedian shooting at himself, a policy meeting, an encounter involving Elton John visiting Ryan White, Sam’s behavior, and a failed commercial. The conversation shifts to Timmy Goggs while attempting to discuss the news.

topics.title: Pittsburgh Delay, Elton John & Traffic Chaos
topics.summary: A radio host delayed in Pittsburgh followed by a chaotic scene involving Elton John’s unusual attire at a funeral – resembling a military captain's outfit with jewels.
